items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated 20.11.2026 (Friday); the letter states the Bescheid was sent by post. Per the delivery rule the letter itself cites ('ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben', § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), counting from the posting day 20.11.2026: day 1 = 21.11 (Sat), day 2 = 22.11 (Sun), day 3 = 23.11 (Mon), day 4 = 24.11.2026 (Tue) → Bekanntgabe on 24.11.2026. Note: the standard text of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X actually provides for a THREE-day fiction, not four; the letter's wording diverges from the commonly known statutory text, so this date carries some uncertainty (see warnings). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG) begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 25.11.2026, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (24.11.) → 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in NRW (Heiligabend is not a legal holiday), so no extension applies.

warnings: The letter states the Bescheid is deemed delivered on the FOURTH day after posting ('am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden'); the standard wording of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X provides a THREE-day delivery fiction, not four — please verify this against the original Bescheid, as it affects the exact start of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist.

The exact posting (Absende-) date was assumed to equal the printed letter date (20.11.2026); if the letter was actually posted on a different day, the Bekanntgabe date and the Widerspruch deadline shift accordingly.
